title: Mosaic Garden Muse
description: A woman with light blue skin and intricate circular mosaic patterns on her face, neck, and chest stands amid vibrant blooming flowers. She holds a small colorful mandala-like object in her raised hand while surrounded by a swirling rainbow mosaic background that transitions from teal to magenta and yellow.
prompt: A woman with light blue skin covered in intricate circular mosaic patterns stands in profile, holding a small colorful mandala in her hand, surrounded by lush vibrant flowers like poppies and irises growing around her body and hair. A massive swirling rainbow mosaic background radiates outward from teal to purple, pink, and golden yellow in a hypnotic circular pattern, detailed fantasy digital painting style.
